Airbyte (Airbyte, Inc., San Francisco, CA) is an open-source ELT data integration platform with 300+ connectors. While marketing references 99.9% uptime for Pro/Cloud plans, the contractual SLA is a non-public "Additional Terms" document not embedded in the main Terms of Service. Marketplace connectors carry no uptime commitment. Enterprise customers should request the full SLA document directly from Airbyte.
